expected_rate: regular-hours ticks on days when a mover passes the screen (911 passes in 12 sessions, 712 of them in the last 3); zero on days with no screened mover (9/26, 9/29, 9/30, 10/06 had none)
window_reason: movers pass the screen on most sessions; three sessions with no line means the logging is broken
reversal: no [track-b-wait] line on a session where the mover screen passed, a wait_code of '?' or 'error' dominating, or any change in which Track B signals ENTER versus before
